svg.title: SD-1 Submit a report and validate it (FR-1 to FR-4, NFR-1, NFR-4)

g.text: SD-1 Submit a report and validate it (FR-1 to FR-4, NFR-1, NFR-4)
the resident does not wait for the AI
[confidence low OR photo is not infrastructure]
operator opens the review list (separate request)
Priority and Notifications consume IssueValidated and
IssueDuplicateDetected next (see SD-2). Notifications tells the
resident about ReportRejected; the dashboard drops it from the review list.
If the handler throws, RabbitMQ redelivers; after 3 failures
the message goes to the dead-letter queue (NFR-3).
